items.title: SSH keys on macOS with Touch ID
items.blurb: I've recently discovered that you can use Touch ID (rather, the Mac's Secure Enclave) for SSH authentication. I'm the author of the post, feel free to ask any questions and if there are any experts I'd love to hear your thoughts!
